question.text: Since October 2019, what settlement method has SEBI mandated for all stock derivatives (futures and options on individual securities) that remain open on expiry?

answer.text: Either cash or physical settlement at the choice of the investor
Net settlement through clearing corporation without delivery

explanation.text: The Logic: Since October 2019, SEBI has mandated physical settlement (settlement by delivery of underlying stock) for all stock derivatives. All positions in futures and options on individual securities which remain open on the expiry date of the contract are to be settled by physical delivery only. However, Index futures and Index options contracts continue to be settled in cash. The Trap: Cash settlement was the earlier practice for stock derivatives. Students may recall the pre-2019 regime. The choice between cash and physical is not available - physical delivery is mandatory for stock derivatives. Index derivatives remain cash-settled, and confusing stock with index derivatives is a common error.
